items.rationale: The swerve damage is covered under 2.6.2, and the scheduled battery health waiver disapplies the below-80% cutoff in 2.6.8. The supplier report supports replacement under 7.1.10: one equivalent new laptop at an estimated €1,400 gross, less any achievable salvage value, none of which is quantified.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to the pre-loss specification, already represented by line 1, and excludes the elective upgrade difference.

Sections 2.6.3 and 2.6.4 cover the tablet's cracked screen as damage to a second unit in the same event. Under 7.1.10, one installed screen repair for the pictured tablet is estimated at €250 gross, with no separate tablet deductible.

Section 5.2.3 covers examination of both units, including the laptop whose repair was uneconomic. The single billed line includes both inspections at about €72 each, for €144 gross, below the €250 event cap.
Sections 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 require the bag itself to have been damaged; buying a new bag with the replacement laptop does not qualify.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude extended warranties even when purchased with an otherwise covered replacement.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately scheduled. The battery health waiver does not provide that cover.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate administrative charges, including those levied by a third-party provider.
